name: ModelVariant460_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant460_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4; for a non-negative request it resolves the config record indexed by the request in the data block, looks up two slot parts, packs the texture images and sets up two panels, two ten-quad groups and rings, domes and sheets this image never draws, otherwise it runs one frame (panels from the config start frame, quad groups from phase 2, light fade) and returns 4 in phases 2-4, 1 once at phase 5, 2 at phase 7 and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the European discs build the header-477 form (FrenchModelVariant477_HandleRequest). HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
